text:
nina-fin: Borealis Labs (renewal BL-2026-09) flagged invoice. They moved from Dedicated -> Private mid-term and say we refunded platform pro-rate but did not reflect a pro-rated refund on the annual support line. AP wants clarification before applying payment.

devin-billing: Can you paste the invoice lines? Need to see how the migration rebate was surfaced.

nina-fin: Redacted snippet:
```
Line 2: PLATFORM_DEDICATED - ($48,000) - SKU PF-DED-2026 (credit for migration)
Line 3: PLATFORM_PRIVATE - $96,000 - SKU PF-PRV-2026
Line 5: SUPPORT_TIER_GOLD - $24,000 - SKU SUP-GOLD-12M
Total due: $120,000
```
Customer says the $48k was a credit against platform but their expectation (per the migration amendment MIG-BL-2026-03) was that support should be pro-rated for months remaining and not billed in full.

tanya-ar: AR note: support is billed annually in advance for this account. If contract amendment required pro-rated support refund we should either issue a credit memo or reissue invoice showing support net of pro-rate. Does MIG-BL-2026-03 explicitly instruct amortization vs. refund?

ravi-cs: The amendment text: "On migration, platform credit applied; customer entitled to pro-rated refund of prepaid support for remainder of term or elect to apply as account credit." Customer selected refund on 2026-03-22 via signed amendment. CS attached signed MIG-BL-2026-03 to the customer record.

devin-billing: Billing export rule defaulted to apply migration as platform SKU credit only. It didn't touch the support SKU because the rule set assumes support remains annual. We'll need a manual adjustment for this case.

billing-bot: Billing run 2026-09-01: created ticket BILL-8105 for manual support pro-rate credit. Assigned to @billing-ops.

nina-fin: Ok action items: 1) @tanya-ar attach signed MIG-BL-2026-03 to BILL-8105, 2) @devin-billing please issue either (A) a credit memo for the pro-rated support amount OR (B) reissue invoice BL-2026-09 with support line netted and memo "See MIG-BL-2026-03 - support refund elected". Customer AP prefers a credit memo they can apply. 3) AR hold cash application until BILL-8105 resolved.

tanya-ar: Uploaded MIG-BL-2026-03 to the ticket and flagged for AR workflow.

devin-billing: Will prepare credit memo CM-BL-2026-09-01 for pro-rated support refund. ETA 2 business days. Will include reference to MIG-BL-2026-03 in memo.

nina-fin: Thanks. I'll notify Borealis AP that a credit memo will be issued and that they can proceed with payment net of that credit once posted.

billing-bot: BILL-8105 status: in progress. Expected close: 2026-09-07.
